view.subline: {name} · every bonus added up from the other pages. This page stores nothing.

pending.title: Some sources are not applied here.
pending.text: Each source below is read from the page that stores it. {unstored} are not applied to these totals. Castle position and Chief Orders are only used in the Plans and when you start a queue.

affinity.title: Expert affinity
affinity.text: An expert gives a base bonus that grows with the affinity level. At levels 10, 20 up to 100 the expert must advance. Until then the bonus of the level before counts.

albums.title: Albums count when complete
albums.text: A Tundra Album gives its buff only when all 9 puzzles are done.

pets.title: Pets use the refined value
pets.text: Each pet counts its normal or its refined value, as you set on the Pets page.

noNumber.title: No number, not counted
noNumber.text: A source that has no number in the data adds nothing. It is not shown as 0.

apart.title: Kept apart
apart.text: Percent and flat values are never added together. Infantry, Lancer and Marksman stats are separate from Troops stats.

time.title: Time stats
time.text: Construction Speed Boost is hours saved for each build. Ally Help Time is in seconds. Each shows its unit.

empty.noBonusesDescription: Bonuses appear as the pages that store them are filled in.
empty.noMatchDescription: Change the search or the group.

eventRules.title: Event buff rules
eventRules.intro: It says which bonus kinds still apply during an event. These are rules, not numbers, so nothing here is added to the totals above.
